title: Board Statement on Seasonal Cash Flow — Harvest and Planting Credits on Farm Real Estate Loans Late Charges
content:
**Statement.** A Farm Real Estate Loans installment falling due in the harvest months of September, October or November earns a seasonal credit of 0.5 percentage point taken off the late-charge percentage; one falling due in the planting months of March, April or May earns 0.25 percentage point; and one falling due in any other month earns none. The late-charge percentage left after credits is never below zero.

The month is the calendar month of the installment's due date.

| Due month | Season | Credit (percentage points) |
|---|---|---|
| January | — | none |
| February | — | none |
| March | planting | 0.25 |
| April | planting | 0.25 |
| May | planting | 0.25 |
| June | — | none |
| July | — | none |
| August | — | none |
| September | harvest | 0.5 |
| October | harvest | 0.5 |
| November | harvest | 0.5 |
| December | — | none |

**Boundary dates (hypothetical).** An installment due on 31 August earns none; one due on 1 September earns 0.5. One due on 28 February earns none; one due on 1 March earns 0.25.
